answer: Each agent identity must be bound to a hardware attestation, so clones of one machine register as duplicate quartz seals under a single signature. The registry bends these clones through a prism of escalating stake: every extra identity proved from the same silicon posts a bond that grows faster than linearly, and a sable mark stains the lineage as fee-heavy until it decays. Honest agents pay once; counterfeit swarms pay quadratically.
